fitReason: Strong connection between learned visual navigation, formal safety and multi-agent interaction, with current UVA robot deployment and publicly documented technical evaluation.

physicalEvidence.summary: Stereo4DWalker (IROS 2026, manuscript revised September 14) is a UVA collaboration including Chandra and his current graduate students. A transformer using stereo/depth/motion features predicts waypoints for a real Clearpath Jackal J100 with ZED 2i. Models run on a remote GPU server, with ROS 2 low-level execution. The physical evaluation uses 14 trials for each of three motion types; reported overall success is 66.7% zero-shot and 73.8% after fine-tuning. Offline arrival metrics are separate. The source establishes participation/current-group access, not exclusive equipment ownership.
